description:
Practice mental arithmetic solo or compete with friends.
"Mental Math" is a simple and clean Android app for mental arithmetic training. You can practice on your own or challenge friends to compete and improve your skills. The app is open source and respects your privacy.

Customizable Training
Select which arithmetic operations to include (+, −, ×, ÷). For each operation, choose from nine difficulty levels to customize your training precisely to your skill level.

Five Game Modes
• Sprint Mode lets you complete a fixed number of problems (10, 20, 30, 40, or 50) as fast as possible.
• Timed Mode challenges you to solve as many problems as possible within a time limit (1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 minutes).
• Survival Mode challenges you to survive 100 problems with 3 lives and a decreasing time limit for each problem.
• Memory Mode shows each number only briefly (0.5 to 2.5 seconds per digit), so you have to keep the rest in your head.
• Training Mode lets you train as long as you want with a fixed number of retries per problem (0, 1, 2, 3, or ∞).

Challenge your Friends
You can share a game link to:
1. Replay a completed game with the exact same problems to compare scores with friends.
2. Start a new game with preset settings for a fair and fresh challenge for everyone.

Difficulty Calculation
Problem difficulty is determined using algorithms based on column addition, column subtraction, long multiplication, and long division, creating realistic and well-balanced exercises.

Detailed Results
After each game, view a detailed summary that includes your selected settings, your performance (accuracy, speed, and score), and a complete list of all your problems and answers for review.

Personal Leaderboard
Your top 10 results are displayed separately for each combination of settings, allowing you to easily track your progress. You can also review detailed summaries of your top games at any time.

Game History
Explore the complete history of all your scored games. You can sort the list by time or settings and filter it by mode and operations. Tap any game to view its results again in full detail.

Practice Reminders
Set up periodic reminders to support regular mental math practice. Notifications are sent in the evening (around 6 p.m.) and can be scheduled daily, every three days, or weekly.

Customizable Interface
Display math problems horizontally or vertically. Set the input direction to left-to-right or right-to-left. Choose your preferred keypad style, either numeric or phone-style.

Sound & Vibration
Choose sound and vibration for clearer, more immediate responses during games. Both options can be enabled or disabled independently. Vibration may depend on your device or system settings.

Keyboard Support
You can control the app entirely with a hardware keyboard for quick and easy navigation and input. The controls are designed for the numpad, but every action also works without one.

Clean Design
A simple and minimalist app design with no unnecessary elements or distractions, designed to keep your focus fully on mental math training. Supports both light and dark modes.

Open Source, Private, Free & Ad-free
"Mental Math" is fully open source, free to use, and does not contain any ads. It also does not collect, store, or process any personal data, nor does it use trackers or third-party services.
